query: Evaluate this repo and tell me where the biggest problems are.
boundary: Canonical positive: whole-repo evaluation. Anchor case; a miss here means the description is broken, not borderline.

query: Do a full audit of this project's code quality and technical debt.
boundary: Project audit / code-quality review / tech-debt analysis - all named explicitly in the description.

query: Use the engineering team to improve this codebase end to end.
boundary: Explicit ask for the engineering team + full evaluate-plan-implement cycle. Must fire.

query: Go through the whole codebase and systematically hunt for bugs.
boundary: Systematic bug-finding across the project (fires) - deliberately adjacent to the quick-targeted-fix negatives (N3, N9). The distinguisher is 'whole codebase / systematically', not a single site.

query: Do a security review of this service before we ship it.
boundary: Security review OF A PROJECT (fires) - near-miss against N4, a single-snippet vulnerability question that should NOT fire.

query: Check that the docs in /docs actually match what the code does.
boundary: Checking documentation accuracy against the code (fires) - near-miss against N5, fixing a single doc typo, which should NOT.

query: We're choosing between Postgres and DynamoDB for this app's data layer. Walk me through the tradeoffs for our case.
boundary: Architecture/tradeoff discussion GROUNDED in this codebase -> Discussion workflow (fires). Near-miss against N6, the same question with no codebase in play.

query: What would change in our architecture if we moved this service off Kafka?
boundary: 'What would change if we moved to Z' - verbatim a Discussion-workflow trigger, grounded in the project (fires). Near-miss against N7, a generic 'how does X work' explainer.

query: Assess the overall architecture of this project and flag the design risks.
boundary: Architecture review of a whole project (fires). Sits near the Discussion cases but is an evaluation, not a decision - both routes land in the skill.

query: What's the current state of the art in retrieval-augmented generation?
boundary: Standalone research question, no codebase in play -> deep-research skill. The description carves this out by name. Anchor negative.

query: Review this PR and tell me if it's good to merge: https://github.com/acme/app/pull/482
boundary: Reviewing a single diff/PR - explicitly excluded. Anchor negative.

query: Fix the off-by-one error in parse_date() in utils.py.
boundary: Quick targeted fix, single known site - explicitly excluded. Anchor negative.

query: Is this login function vulnerable to SQL injection? def login(u): db.query("select * from users where name='" + u + "'")
boundary: Single-snippet security question, not a project security review -> targeted, does NOT fire. Near-miss against P5. The distinguisher is scope: one function vs a service.

query: Fix the broken link and the typo in the README.
boundary: Targeted single-doc fix, not a docs-vs-code accuracy audit -> does NOT fire. Near-miss against P6.

query: In general, should I use Postgres or MySQL for a new side project?
boundary: Tradeoff question with NO codebase in play -> research, not the Discussion workflow. Near-miss against P7; 'in general' / 'a new side project' is the tell that it is ungrounded.

query: Explain how React's reconciliation algorithm works.
boundary: General explainer, no codebase decision -> not the Discussion workflow. Near-miss against P8.

query: Add a dark-mode toggle to the settings page.
boundary: A single scoped feature request, not a whole-codebase review or an end-to-end improvement cycle -> does NOT fire (feature-dev territory). Deliberate boundary case: 'improve this codebase' fires, one feature does not.

query: Review the changes on my current branch before I open a PR.
boundary: A single-diff review (the uncommitted branch), not a whole-repo evaluation -> does NOT fire. Near-miss against P1: 'review my changes' vs 'evaluate this repo'.
